ChickyTutor is an AI conversation partner for people who want to speak another language with more confidence. Instead of stopping at vocabulary drills, learners practise saying useful things aloud, receive a focused correction, and try the idea again in a more natural way. The browser experience supports speaking practice across more than 70 languages and regional variants. [...] Learners choose a target language, an instruction language, a level, and a practice style. ChickyTutor can guide a beginner with explanations, sustain a more immersive conversation, or follow a structured Journey chapter. Public language pages, writing activities, level checks, fill-in-the-gap exercises, and listening podcasts provide additional ways to prepare before or review after a conversation.

Start with open conversation or a practical scenario such as meeting someone, travelling, ordering food, preparing for work, or discussing lesson material.

The tutor responds to what you meant, highlights a useful grammar, wording, or pronunciation improvement, and keeps the exchange moving without turning every turn into a test.
